# ctables/shl

> Shift left: `<<`.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/shl.pkg) · translates [std/shl](../std/shl.md)

  The count is taken modulo 64, like the x86 `shl` instruction, so every
  count is defined.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
{L.a} << ({L.b} & 63); })
```

Includes: [ctables/binop](binop.md)
